title: Add Footer
content: Build comprehensive footer component. Structure with multiple columns: Company info (logo, description, social icons), Product links, Resources, Legal. Use responsive grid: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5. Add newsletter signup with email input and subscribe button. Include social icons (Twitter, LinkedIn, GitHub) using lucide-react. Bottom bar with copyright, language selector, and legal links. Style with dark background (bg-gray-900 text-gray-300) or light (bg-gray-100). Add hover effects on links. Include app store badges if mobile app. Ensure proper spacing and mobile-friendly stacking. Add back-to-top button.

variants.simple: Build a footer with company info, navigation links, and social icons.

variants.advanced: Build comprehensive footer component with all necessary sections and accessibility. Structure: footer element with bg-gray-900 text-gray-300 (dark) or bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 (light). Inner container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12 lg:py-16. Grid layout: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-8. Column 1 (larger): Company logo, brief description (max 2-3 sentences), social icons row with hover color effects. Columns 2-5: Link groups with heading (font-semibold text-white mb-4) and list of links (space-y-2). Link categories: Product (Features, Pricing, Integrations), Resources (Blog, Documentation, Help Center), Company (About, Careers, Contact), Legal (Privacy, Terms, Cookies). Newsletter section: full width or in column, email input with Subscribe button, success/error states, privacy note. Social icons: flex gap-4, icon buttons with hover:text-white transition, Twitter, LinkedIn, GitHub, Instagram, YouTube as relevant. Bottom bar: border-t border-gray-800 mt-12 pt-8, flex justify-between flex-wrap, copyright text, language/region selector, legal links. App store badges: Apple App Store and Google Play if applicable. Back to top button: fixed bottom-right, appears after scrolling down, smooth scroll to top. ACCESSIBILITY: proper heading hierarchy in footer, links with clear text, social links with aria-labels, newsletter form with label. Responsive: columns stack to 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile. Consider reduced footer variant for app/dashboard pages.
